scope: Card 59: phase 4 closeout — legacy switch and migrated-family full scans removed, probe gating decided, diagnostics and assembly preview derived from the structure definition, docs aligned
stacked_on: feat/structure-edge-side-effects (PR #129, open at the time of this run)
source: New implementation against the local card contract; no third-party source, assets or dependencies imported
implementation: StructureTrackingMode and the multiblock.structureTracking config value deleted; all legacy branches removed from query, invalidate, chunk unload, removal, claims, scheduler and parts
scanStructure deleted from fourteen migrated families; LargeRecipeMachineBlockEntity keeps its scan for the large-recipe families that are still not incremental
The test-build consistency oracle now builds a fresh PatternState from the same CompiledPattern and applies the resulting match instead of calling the removed scan bodies
Probe mixins stay in the production config; every probe entry returns on activeScans == 0 before touching thread state, and inScan() gained the same fast path
StructureDiagnostic.inspect compiles the machine's own definition and lists every rejected cell without early stop; optional repeat layers above the minimum are not reported
Boiler and heat-exchanger magnifier messages append the diagnostic problems when the structure is not formed

Tank, logistics, drill and lightning-rod cells moved into SpecialStructures builders used by both the runtime definitions and the JEI/EMI preview; exchanger and crucible preview read the shared CELLS; logistics core added to the preview list
StructureWatchIndex.touch(level, pos) added for addon parts whose matching data changes without a block-state change
ADDON_API.md, ADDON_API.zh-CN.md, DECISIONS.md and the tracking plan updated; the docs contract classifies StructureWatchIndex

new_tests: previewAndJeiDrawTheDefinitionCells (tank, exchanger, lightning rod, large-recipe layout)

client_smoke.cause: The probe blocks are registered by the gametest source set (SignalProbes) that the client smoke includes; card 59 did not modify SignalProbes, MachineModelSmoke, pipe models or their sprites
client_smoke.conclusion: Client startup was not accepted; the magnifier and JEI/EMI preview still have no client visual verification

iteration_notes: First Forge run exposed two test-harness assumptions that the old scan oracle had been satisfying: two tests counted scans that no longer happen, and ControllerStructureLayouts initialization hit part id 0 through the new preview helper. Both were fixed in the test/helper layer; the production checks were unchanged.
The preview consistency test uses largecrusher because distillation tower geometry is not registered in LargeMachineLayouts
not_done: Client startup smoke was attempted on Forge and failed before the title screen on an unrelated gametest probe model (pipe_probe_fluid/pipe_probe_item); it is not counted as a client pass, and the magnifier and JEI/EMI preview still have no client visual verification
No full default GameTest suite on either platform; only the two structure namespaces were run, per the task-level verification rule
No saved-world restart test; storage format is unchanged
PER_CELL stays disabled; every family runs ATOMIC
LargeRecipeMachineBlockEntity and the large-recipe families that are still not incremental keep their full scan
